sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.body: These terms apply to all services provided by webvise (Sebastian Kehle), including design, development, automation, and consulting services. By engaging these services, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: 2. Services
sections.body: The scope, deliverables, timeline, and cost of each engagement are defined in a written proposal. Work begins only after mutual agreement on the proposal. Changes to scope are documented and may affect timeline and cost.

sections.heading: 3. Payment
items: Ongoing support engagements: Invoiced monthly at the beginning of each period.
Payment is due within 14 days of invoice date.
All prices are net and subject to applicable VAT.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.body: Upon full payment, all intellectual property rights to deliverables transfer to you. webvise retains the right to use the work in its portfolio unless otherwise agreed. Third-party licenses (fonts, libraries, services) remain subject to their respective terms.

sections.heading: 5. Warranties
sections.body: Work is delivered to professional standards, and post-launch bug fixes are provided at no extra cost. Specific business outcomes (revenue, rankings, conversions) are not guaranteed, as they depend on factors beyond webvise's control.

sections.heading: 6. Liability
sections.body: webvise's liability is limited to the total fees paid for the engagement in question. It is not liable for indirect, consequential, or lost profit damages. This does not affect liability for intent or gross negligence under German law.

sections.heading: 7. Confidentiality
sections.body: Both parties agree to keep confidential information private. This includes business strategies, technical details, and any non-public information shared during the engagement.

sections.heading: 8. AI Features and Third-Party Services
sections.body: This website uses AI-powered features, including a chat widget (powered by Google Gemini via Vercel AI Gateway) and a WP Health Report tool (which queries the Google PageSpeed Insights API). AI-generated responses are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute professional advice, binding offers, or guaranteed accuracy. webvise is not liable for decisions made based on AI-generated content. The services may depend on third-party platforms (hosting, APIs, AI providers). webvise is not responsible for outages, changes, or limitations imposed by these providers.

sections.heading: 9. Termination
sections.body: Either party may terminate with 14 days written notice. Work completed up to termination is invoiced proportionally. Ongoing support engagements may be cancelled at the end of any billing period.

sections.heading: 10. Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by German law. The place of jurisdiction is Potsdam, Germany.
